attributes.action: Implement licencing for the purchase and use of fireworks
attributes.additional_details:
Restricting the sale to only licenced venues will ensure residential area stay quiet and pets/wildlife are less affected.

By enforcing displays to happen on pre-agreed dates only e.g. 5th November. Currently people celebrate weeks in advance causing disruption for longer than needed.

This would allow only 1 occurrence for that holiday, minimising disruption and allowing the public to plan in advance if they don't wish to take part or hear the festivities.
attributes.background:
The purchasing and use of fireworks should require a pre-approved licence.

Implementing this should reduce the use of fireworks in residential areas.

Alongside this, specific events in the year such as Bonfire Night and New Year's Eve should have enforced dates/times.

rejection.details:
We already have a few petitions open that between them seem to cover what you are asking for in your petition. You may wish to sign one or more of them:

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893

Ban all loud fireworks and only allow silent ones to be sold in the UK
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/786349

Fireworks only to be used on Guy Fawkes night with a 10pm curfew to protect dogs
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/786374
